title: 第9章  九转金丹，方玄没死？
content_zh:
简陋破败的房间之中，放置着一个热气蒸腾的木桶。
方玄取出一个药瓶，小心翼翼的将一滴药液倒入水中。
“咕嘟咕嘟！”
药液刚一融入水中，木桶中顿时翻滚起黑色的水泡，腥臭刺鼻的味道顿时弥漫房间。
这滴药液，正是龙骨灵液。
龙骨灵液蕴含着极为狂暴的药力，直接吸收人体根本承受不住，所以需要融入热水之中才行。
褪去全身衣服，方玄钻进木桶。
“嘶！”
刚一进入木桶，热水中就像是有千万只蚂蚁，不断撕咬着方玄的皮肤，像是要钻入他的体内，破坏他的五脏六腑。
“好恐怖的龙骨灵液，还没吸收就差点让我承受不住。”
方玄痛得五官扭曲，身上青筋暴露，差点叫出声来，跳出木桶。
但方玄知道，他必须要忍住。
若是连这点痛苦都承受不住，他还如何战胜方霄，如何登临武道巅峰。
狠狠咬着牙，方玄取出一枚气血丹。
气血丹适用于造血境武者服用。
一旦服下，可刺激肉身，制造气血，壮大自身实力。
方玄如今的实力，已经达到造血境巅峰，距离炼体境只差一步。
但他很清楚。
虽说混沌圣体为他塑造了恐怖的武道根基，但同时也让他每次破境，都需要海量的资源。
而龙骨灵液配合气血丹，则能够更大限度的刺激肉身，制造更多的气血。

而方玄今日的目的，并非是为了突破修为。
而是......重塑丹田！
毫不犹豫的将气血丹服下，丹药顿时化作一股澎湃的药力，冲击四肢百骸。
两种力量在体内乱窜，那种痛苦，绝对不是一加一等于二那么简单。
心志不坚之辈，根本坚持不了多久。
强忍意识昏厥的冲动，方玄盘腿坐在木桶之中，双手结印。
他此次运转的，并非是太初女帝的《太初混沌经》，而是丹鼎女帝的《九转丹神录》。
随着功法运转，体内的力量顿时得到梳理，被方玄引导，穿过道道经脉，最后融入到方玄的气海之中。
气海之中，因为丹田被苏清瑶废去，即便他凝聚了混沌圣体，如此也如同一盘散沙，裂成无数碎片。
在方玄运转《九转丹神录》的同时，他的识海之中，一尊刻满山川河流的洪荒丹鼎，缓缓浮现而出。
丹鼎气息澎湃，好似能够镇压天地。
鼎身之上，两个龙飞凤舞的大字，映入方玄眼帘之中。
乾坤鼎！
这也是丹鼎女帝的本命帝兵，更是世间一等一的炼丹至宝、极道帝兵。
只是在与人交战之时，乾坤鼎被敌人破去，早已化作无数碎片，分散四方。
因此，这只是一道乾坤鼎的幻影，并非本体。
在乾坤鼎出现之时，五彩丹气自鼎中蒸腾而起，冲入方玄身体，涌入气海之中。
这些五彩丹气，如同无数丝线般，将破碎成散沙的丹田碎片彼此连接，慢慢拉拢、淬炼。
不知过了多久，方玄的丹田之中，竟然多了一颗刻满九道帝纹的金丹。
在金丹出现的瞬间，方玄豁然睁开双眼。

眼中精光绽放，嘴角掀起一抹发自内心的狂喜。
“九转金丹，成了！”
压住兴奋，方玄尝试运转九转金丹。
“呼呼呼！”
霎时间，气血丹和龙骨灵液的力量，源源不断涌入身体，刺激肉身极限，制造出更多的精纯气血，涌入金色丹田之中。
前后不过几个呼吸的功夫，气血丹和龙骨灵液的力量，就被吸收一空。
“这九转金丹的力量，还真是恐怖。”
方玄惊叹不已。
太初混沌经，可以让方玄凝聚混沌圣体，而九转丹神录，则是让方玄凝聚出九转金丹。
他丹田重塑，才能更进一步。
否则，将永远被卡死在造血境，不得寸进。
“如今丹田已塑，就该一鼓作气，争取破境！”
方玄毫不犹豫将剩下的龙骨灵液，全部倒入水中，又服用了一颗气血丹。
双手结印，一心二用。
一边运转太初混沌经，一边运转九转丹神录，疯狂的汲取着木桶中的药力。
“轰隆隆！”
狂暴的药力，涌入身体，巨大的刺痛，撕扯着方玄的肉身和意识。
但经历过死亡的他，心志之坚韧，早已达到一个恐怖的地步。
“这点痛苦，又怎比得上废脉碎丹夺骨之痛！”
方玄嗤笑一声，轻闭双眼。

脸上，再无半点痛苦。
只有平静、淡然。
而在方玄沉入修炼的同时。
青阳郡。
一名护卫跪在苏扬面前，头也不敢抬。
“公子，咱们派去的人失手了，那小子也逃走了。”
早已服下丹药，调整气息的苏扬闻言，闻言顿时将手中的茶杯摔在地上。
“真是废物，连一个小畜生都对付不了，我养你们有何用！”
那名护卫身体一颤，大气都不敢喘。
“继续给本公子查！”
苏扬怒不可遏，厉声道：“就算是掘地三尺，也要给我把那小畜生找出来，我要将他碎尸万段，方能解我心头之恨！”
从小到大，他何曾受过此等羞辱。
天宝楼也就罢了，他苏家现在还得罪不起。
但一个不知道从哪里冒出来的小畜生，也敢不将他苏扬放在眼里。
这口气，必须出！
“公子放心，我一定会将那小子揪出来，让他跪在公子面前，给公子赔罪！”
面对手下的保证，苏扬却是不耐烦的挥挥手。
“滚吧。
那人诚惶诚恐的退出屋外，才发现后背都被冷汗打湿了。
“你，过来！”

怒火未消的苏扬，指向一名侍女。
那名侍女顿时脸色煞白，却又不敢反抗，娇躯颤抖着走向苏扬。
“嗤啦！”
苏扬不由分说，将对方拉入怀中，粗暴的撕去侍女的衣物，欲行禽兽之事。
就见一名中年男子踏进屋内，见状脸色一沉，呵斥道：“逆子，你在干什么？”
“父亲，您怎么来了？”
刚要发火的苏扬看清来人，脸上顿时露出一个讨好笑容。
苏崇明挥挥手，将差点惨遭毒手的侍女打发下去，这才恨铁不成钢的怒声道。
“我怎么生了你这么个不成器的逆子，看看你这样子，成何体统。”
苏扬却是不以为意，反而笑呵呵的说道：“父亲，您来找我，应该不是为了骂我几句吧。”
苏崇明冷哼一声，说道：“听说你今日在天宝楼，与人发生争执了？”
“父亲，您都知道了？”
苏扬有些心虚，不敢直视苏崇明。
“你以为你能瞒得住我？”
苏崇明一瞪眼，说道：“你当天宝楼是什么地方，是你能随意撒野的吗？”
“父亲，这天宝楼到底是什么来头，难道连咱们苏家都得罪不起吗？”
苏扬不以为意，脸上满是不屑。
“废话！”
苏崇明说道：“莫说是我苏家，就算是咱们三大家族加起来，也得罪不起这天宝楼。”
“父亲，您是不是糊涂了？”

苏扬嗤笑道：“我姐已经拜入问道宗，那方家和李家，岂能与咱们苏家相提并论？”
“哼，懒得与你争辩。”
话虽如此，但提及此事，苏崇明脸上还是不由得露出一抹骄傲之色。
问道宗，乃是整个青州最强宗之一，足以排进前三。
其宗门传承超过千年之久，号称弟子三千，底蕴深厚。
可以说，一旦拜入问道宗，就算是半只脚踏入了顶尖强者的行列。
而其家族势力，也随之鸡犬升天，享受荣光。
更别说，他苏崇明的女儿苏清瑶，还被问道宗内门弟子赵擎苍看重，早晚结成道侣。
到那时，别说这青阳郡，就算是整个青州地界，也有他苏家的一席之地。
“说起来，这件事还得多亏了方玄那个废物。”
苏扬得意扬扬的说道：“若非那废物，为我苏家提供那么多资源，咱们哪有现在的好日子。”
“当然，以我姐的姿色和天赋，就算没有那个废物，我姐迟早也能拜入问道宗。”
苏扬立马改口道：“甚至成为问道宗圣女，也不是不可能。”
“可惜啊，那废物已经死了，哈哈哈。”
说完，苏扬不由得狂笑起来，显得特别畅快。
但苏崇明的脸色却瞬间阴沉了下来。
“我刚收到消息，那小畜生没死。”
闻言，苏扬先是一愣，随即尖声道：“什么？这怎么可能，他不是.....”
“此事千真万确。”
苏崇明说道：“那方玄不仅没死，而且还恢复了修为。今日刚一回来，就大闹了一场，更扬言要在十日后，与方霄生死战。”

“和方霄生死战？”
苏扬顿时倒吸一口凉气，满脸难以置信。
“他怎么敢的？”
虽说苏扬自恃实力不俗，但和方霄之间也有不少差距。
那方玄，明明已经废物了三年，他哪来的底气，敢和方霄生死战？
“不管他哪来的底气，有何凭仗，十日之后自见分晓。”
苏崇明眼中杀意闪烁，冷声道：“无论如何，那小畜生都绝对不能活着。”
旁人不知，但苏崇明却十分清楚。
苏清瑶之所以能进入问道宗，是因为出卖了方玄。
方玄活着，就永远是他苏家心头的一根刺，必须拔除。
“父亲，要不要......”
苏扬做了一个抹脖子的动作。
“不必。”
苏崇明微微一笑，说道：“想要那小畜生死的人，可不止咱们。”
苏扬一怔，随即笑道：“也对。现在最想要方玄死的，反而不是咱们苏家，而是......方霄！”
各大家族的家主之争，历来都要经历一番血雨腥风。
这三年来，方霄一直以方家少主自居。
方玄的回归，对方霄来说，就是一块拦路石，势必要将其击碎的。
“既然如此，那咱们就等着看好戏吧。”
父子俩对视一眼，脸上皆是露出幸灾乐祸的阴冷笑容。
content_en:
In the simple and dilapidated room, there was a steaming wooden barrel.
Fang Xuan took out a medicine bottle and carefully poured a drop of medicine into the water.
"Grrrrrrrr!"
As soon as the liquid medicine melted into the water, black bubbles suddenly rolled up in the wooden barrel, and a fishy and pungent smell suddenly filled the room.
This drop of medicine is exactly Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid.
Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid contains extremely violent medicinal power, and the human body cannot bear it if it is absorbed directly, so it needs to be blended into hot water.
After taking off all his clothes, Fang Xuan got into the barrel.
"Hiss!"
As soon as he entered the barrel, it was like there were tens of millions of ants in the hot water, biting Fang Xuan's skin, as if they were trying to penetrate into his body and destroy his internal organs.
"What a terrifying dragon bone spirit liquid. I almost couldn't bear it even before I absorbed it."
Fang Xuan's facial features were distorted in pain, and the veins on his body were exposed. He almost screamed and jumped out of the barrel.
But Fang Xuan knew that he had to hold back.
If he couldn't bear even this little pain, how could he defeat Fang Xiao and reach the pinnacle of martial arts.
Gritting his teeth hard, Fang Xuan took out a Qi and Blood Pill.
Qi and Blood Pill is suitable for hematopoiesis realm warriors.
Once taken, it can stimulate the physical body, create qi and blood, and strengthen one's own strength.
Fang Xuan's current strength has reached the peak of the blood-making realm, and is only one step away from the body-refining realm.
But he knew it.
Although the Holy Body of Chaos gave him a terrifying martial arts foundation, it also required him to require massive resources every time he broke through.
The dragon bone spirit liquid combined with the Qi and Blood Pill can stimulate the physical body to a greater extent and create more Qi and blood.
And Fang Xuan's purpose today is not to break through in cultivation.
But...reshape Dantian!
He took the Qi and Blood Pill without hesitation, and the pill immediately turned into a surge of medicinal power, impacting his limbs and bones.
The two forces are running wildly in the body, and the pain is definitely not as simple as one plus one equals two.
Those who are weak-willed will not be able to persist for long.
Resisting the urge to faint, Fang Xuan sat cross-legged in the barrel and formed a seal with his hands.
What he is running this time is not the Taichu Sutra of Chaos written by Empress Taichu, but the "Nine Revolutions of Alchemy Record" written by Empress Aland Ding.
With the movement of the technique, the power in the body was immediately sorted out, guided by Fang Xuan, passed through the meridians, and finally integrated into Fang Xuan's sea of ​​qi.
In the Qi Sea, because the Dantian was destroyed by Su Qingyao, even if he condensed the Chaos Holy Body, it would be like a plate of loose sand, split into countless fragments.
While Fang Xuan was running the "Nine Revolutions of Alchemy Record", in his sea of ​​consciousness, a prehistoric alchemy cauldron engraved with mountains and rivers slowly emerged.
The aura of the alchemy cauldron is surging, as if it can suppress the heaven and the earth.
On top of the tripod, two large characters with flying dragons and phoenixes came into Fang Xuan's eyes.
Qiankun Ding!
This is also Empress Aland Cauldron's natal imperial weapon, and it is the world's first-class alchemy treasure and ultimate imperial weapon.
However, when fighting with others, the Qiankun Cauldron was broken by the enemy and had already turned into countless fragments, scattered in all directions.
Therefore, this is just an illusion of the Qiankun Cauldron, not its true nature.
When the Qiankun Cauldron appeared, the colorful pill energy steamed up from the cauldron, rushed into Fang Xuan's body, and poured into the sea of ​​qi.
These colorful alchemy energies, like countless threads, connect the fragments of the Dantian broken into loose sand with each other, slowly pulling them together and tempering them.
I don't know how long it took, but there was a golden elixir in Fang Xuan's dantian that was engraved with nine emperor patterns.
The moment the golden elixir appeared, Fang Xuan suddenly opened his eyes.
His eyes sparkled, and the corner of his mouth revealed a touch of ecstasy from the bottom of his heart.
"Nine Transformations Golden Pill, it's done!"
Suppressing his excitement, Fang Xuan tried to use the Nine Turns Golden Pill.
"Hoo ho ho!"
In an instant, the power of Qi and Blood Pills and Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid poured into the body continuously, stimulating the physical body to its limits, creating more pure Qi and blood, and pouring into the golden Dantian.
In just a few breaths, with the power of Qi-Blood Pill and Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid,It was absorbed completely.
"The power of this Nine Transformations Golden Pill is truly terrifying."
Fang Xuan was amazed.
The Taichu Chaos Sutra allows Fang Xuan to condense the Chaos Holy Body, while the Nine-turning Pill Divine Record allows Fang Xuan to condense the Nine-turning Golden Pill.
Only by reshaping his Dantian can he take a step further.
Otherwise, you will be stuck in the hematopoietic realm forever, unable to make any progress.
"Now that the Dantian has been shaped, it's time to work hard and strive for breakthrough!"
Fang Xuan did not hesitate to pour all the remaining dragon bone spirit liquid into the water, and took another Qi and Blood Pill.
Put your hands in a mudra and do two things at once.
While running the Taichu Chaos Sutra, he was running the Nine Revolutions Alchemy Record, frantically absorbing the medicinal power in the barrel.
"Boom!"
The violent medicinal power poured into his body, and the huge stinging pain tore at Fang Xuan's body and consciousness.
But having experienced death, his tenacity has already reached a terrifying level.
"How can this little pain compare to the pain of bone-snatching with the broken veins and broken pills!"
Fang Xuan sneered and closed his eyes lightly.
There was no more pain on his face.
Only calmness and indifference.
While Fang Xuan was sinking into cultivation.
Qingyang County.
A guard knelt in front of Su Yang, not daring to raise his head.
"Sir, the person we sent missed, and that kid also escaped."
Su Yang, who had already taken the elixir and adjusted his breath, heard this and immediately dropped the tea cup in his hand to the ground.
"What a waste. You can't even deal with a little beast. What's the use of raising you!"
The guard's body trembled and he didn't dare to breathe.
"Continue to check for me!"
Su Yang was furious and said sternly: "Even if you have to dig three feet into the ground, you have to find that little beast for me. I have to cut him into pieces to relieve the hatred in my heart!"
Ever since he was a child, he had never suffered such humiliation.
That's it for Tianbao Tower, the Su family can't afford to offend him now.
But a little beast who appeared out of nowhere dared not to take Su Yang seriously.
This tone must be spoken!
"Don't worry, Young Master, I will definitely find that kid out, make him kneel in front of Young Master, and apologize to Young Master!"
Faced with the assurance from his subordinates, Su Yang waved his hand impatiently.
"Go away.
The man left the house in fear, only to find that his back was wet with cold sweat.
"You, come here! "
Su Yang, still angry, pointed at a maid.
The maid suddenly turned pale, but she did not dare to resist. Her delicate body trembled and she walked towards Su Yang.
"Tsk! "
Su Yang couldn't help but pull the girl into his arms, and roughly tore off the maid's clothes, intending to act like an animal.
I saw a middle-aged man step into the house, his face darkened when he saw this, and he yelled: "Young man, what are you doing? "
"Father, why are you here? "
Su Yang, who was about to get angry, saw the person clearly, and a flattering smile suddenly appeared on his face.
Su Chongming waved his hand and sent the maid away who was almost killed, and then said angrily that he hated the iron.
"Why did I give birth to such an incompetent and rebellious son like you? Look at how decent you are like this. "
Su Yang didn't take it seriously, but said with a smile: "Father, you didn't come to me just to scold me. "
Su Chongming snorted coldly and said, "I heard that you had a dispute with someone in Tianbao Tower today? "
"Father, do you know everything? "
Su Yang felt guilty and did not dare to look directly at Su Chongming.
"You think you can hide it from me? "
Su Chongming glared and said: "Where is Tianbao Tower, where you can run wild at will? "
"Father, what is the origin of Tianbao Tower? Can't we even afford to offend our Su family? "
Su Yang didn't take it seriously, his face was full of disdain.
"Nonsense! "
Su Chongming said: "Not to mention my Su family, even our three major families combined cannot afford to offend Tianbao Tower. "
"Father, are you confused? "
Su Yang sneered and said: "My sister has become a Taoist sect, so what about the Fang family and the Li family?"How can our family be compared with our Su family? "
"Huh, I'm too lazy to argue with you. "
Even so, when Su Chongming mentioned this matter, he couldn't help but show a look of pride on his face.
The Taoist Sect is one of the strongest sects in Qingzhou, enough to rank among the top three.
His sect has been passed down for more than a thousand years, and he has three thousand disciples, so he has a profound foundation.
It can be said that once you join the Taoist Sect, you will have half a foot in the ranks of the top experts.
And the power of his family also ascended to heaven and enjoyed the glory.
Not to mention, his Su Chongming's daughter Su Qingyao was valued by Zhao Qingcang, an inner disciple of the Taoist sect, and sooner or later they became a Taoist couple.
By then, not to mention Qingyang County, even the entire Qingzhou territory, his Su family will have a place.
"Speaking of which, this incident is all thanks to that good-for-nothing Fang Xuan. "
Su Yang said proudly: "If that waste hadn't provided so many resources to my Su family, we wouldn't have the good life we have now. "
"Of course, with my sister's beauty and talent, even without that loser, my sister would be able to join the Taoist Sect sooner or later. "
Su Yang immediately changed his words: "It is not impossible to become a Taoist saint. "
"What a pity, that waste is already dead, hahaha. "
After saying that, Su Yang couldn't help laughing wildly, looking particularly happy.
But Su Chongming's face instantly darkened.
"I just received the news that the little beast is not dead. "
Hearing this, Su Yang was stunned for a moment, then screamed: "What? How is this possible, he is not..."
“This is absolutely true. "
Su Chongming said: "Not only did Fang Xuan survive, but he also recovered his cultivation. As soon as he came back today, he made a big fuss, and even threatened to fight Fang Xiao to the death in ten days. "
"A life and death battle with Fang Xiao? "
Su Yang suddenly took a breath of cold air, his face full of disbelief.
"How dare he? "
Although Su Yang prides himself on his strength, there are still many gaps between him and Fang Xiao.
That Fang Xuan has obviously been useless for three years. Where does he have the confidence to dare to fight Fang Xiao to the death?
"No matter where he gets his confidence or what he relies on, it will be clear in ten days. "
Su Chongming's eyes flashed with murderous intent, and he said coldly: "No matter what, that little beast will never survive. "
Others don't know, but Su Chongming knows it very well.
The reason why Su Qingyao was able to enter the Taoist Sect was because he betrayed Fang Xuan.
As long as Fang Xuan is alive, he will always be a thorn in the heart of the Su family and must be removed.
"Father, do you want..."
Su Yang made a gesture of wiping his neck.
"No need. "
Su Chongming smiled slightly and said: "We are not the only ones who want that little beast to die. "
Su Yang was startled, then smiled and said: "That's right. The person who wants Fang Xuan dead most now is not our Su family, but... Fang Xiao! "
The battles between the heads of major families have always been bloody.
In the past three years, Fang Xiao has always regarded himself as the young master of the Fang family.
